speech.heard: Most major nations power city kitchens with clean fuel. One giant breaks this pattern. Under WHO guidelines, kerosene is excluded from clean cooking fuels. Look at China, India, and Nigeria, which giant falls behind. China and India both supply 96% of their urban populations with clean fuels. The odd one out is Nigeria, where urban access is 49%. At the absolute bottom, South Sudan has zero percent. What fuel powers the kitchens in your city?
